outcome: Hospital type performing external cephalic version
Gestational age at external cephalic version
Success rate of external cephalic version
Use of abdominal binder after successful version
cohort: Responses from 234 hospitals in Germany surveyed in 2018 on their approach to external cephalic version
finding: The approach used in Germany to carry out external cephalic version is based on the (expired) German guideline on breech presentation and may need to be re-evaluated based on more recent international guidelines.
mod_finding: External cephalic version is the preferred (61.7%) obstetrical procedure to deal with breech presentation, rather than vaginal breech birth or primary cesarean section.
